info.name: C2PA Watermark Toolkit API
info.description: Set base_url and api_key. If the server uses REQUIRE_API_KEY=false, api_key may be empty. A supplied key is always validated.

formdata.description: Required PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, HEIF, or AVIF image. Configured limits are reported by /api/v1/capabilities.
Required PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, HEIF, or AVIF image.
auto relaxes detection only with corroboration; strict minimizes false positives; assume_ai increases recall with more false-positive risk.
cv2 is fast classical inpainting; migan and lama are more resource-intensive neural backends.
Remove recognized AI/C2PA provenance from the result. This is not a full purge of ordinary metadata.
Required supported image. Region coordinates use its original pixel dimensions.
JSON string with 1-20 [x,y,width,height] boxes inside the image; x/y is the top-left corner.
cv2, migan, or lama inpainting backend.
telea or ns OpenCV algorithm; used only when backend=cv2.
Expand each mask outward by 0-100 pixels before inpainting.
Remove recognized AI/C2PA provenance from the result.
Required supported image.

true retains ordinary non-AI fields while removing AI/C2PA information; false drops allowlisted text fields more aggressively. Format-specific processing means false is not a guarantee that every metadata item is blank.
Required PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, HEIF, or AVIF image.
controlnet preserves edges and structure; sdxl is lighter; qwen prioritizes text/structure but needs cloud-class CUDA.
Optional 0-1 diffusion strength. Leave disabled/omitted for the vendor-adaptive default.
1-200 denoising steps. More steps take longer and do not guarantee a better result.
Optional integer seed for reproducibility under a fixed model and environment.
Run even when no local invisible signal is detected; may alter a clean image.
Remove recognized AI/C2PA provenance from the generated result.
0-8192 long-side cap before diffusion; 0 disables the cap.
0-4096 long-side floor before diffusion; 0 disables upscaling.
Use overlapping tiles only when the long side exceeds tile_size.
512-2048 square tile edge in pixels.
0-512 overlap pixels for feather blending and seam reduction.
